name: Morpheus8
intro: Addresses structure and surface together in a single treatment, working on tightening, texture and definition simultaneously.
statement: Addresses *structure and surface* together: *tightening, texture and definition.*
how: Morpheus8 combines fine needles with radiofrequency, treating structure and surface in the same pass. Needle depth and energy are adjustable, so a single device can be tuned to the layer we need to reach. It is supported by a substantial body of published research.

handpieces.title: Morpheus8 (Face and neck)
handpieces.text: The original handpiece, for facial tightening, texture and definition.

handpieces.title: Morpheus8 Body (Body)
handpieces.text: A larger handpiece adapted for tightening and texture on the body.

handpieces.title: Morpheus8 Eyes (Under-eye)
handpieces.text: A precise handpiece for the delicate under-eye area.

handpieces.title: Morpheus8 Burst (All areas)
handpieces.text: A handpiece that delivers energy in a faster burst pattern.

Reduced appearance of scarring and pores

tiers.title: Rejuvenation
tiers.text: Lower-depth energy for general skin quality and early textural change, with the least downtime of the three.

tiers.title: Corrective
tiers.text: Targets more established texture, scarring and early laxity by working at a deeper layer beneath the surface.

tiers.title: Intensive
tiers.text: The deepest setting, for structural laxity and more established concerns, usually planned as a course.

suits: Patients with mild to moderate concerns who want a considered option without surgery.
notSuitable: Active skin infections, certain pigmentary conditions, pacemakers or implanted devices, or pregnancy.
assessed: Skin condition, laxity and any contraindicating conditions are reviewed in consultation.
before: Skin is cleansed and a topical anaesthetic applied to minimise discomfort.
during: The device is passed across the treatment area, with settings adjusted to your skin and goals.
after: Mild redness and swelling are expected for a short period afterwards.
risks: Risks may include prolonged redness, pigment changes or, rarely, infection; discussed in full at consultation.
